dataset.name: HAI 23.05
dataset.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 as stated by the dataset repository
dataset.trace_kind: recorded realistic ICS testbed augmented with hardware-in-the-loop simulation
dataset.download_policy: Raw third-party files stay outside git. A verifier must download from the official repository and reject any size or digest mismatch.

split_policy.fit: hai-train1.csv through hai-train3.csv only; these files contain normal operation
split_policy.normal_calibration: hai-train4.csv only; used for robust normalization and alert threshold calibration without attack labels
split_policy.final_test: hai-test2.csv plus label-test2.csv opened exactly once after candidate and threshold selection

projection.output_schema: Ferrum PhysicalState v1 with an explicit availability mask

available_dimensions.health: one minus a robust aggregate deviation of documented physical process measurements from normal-training envelopes
available_dimensions.progress: normalized aggregate process activity from measured flow and load channels
available_dimensions.vibration: maximum absolute P2_VIBTR01..04 displacement normalized by the documented P2_VTR01..04 limits
available_dimensions.fault: documented physical measurement outside its training-derived robust safety envelope; attack labels are never an input
available_dimensions.online: one only when the timestamp is continuous and all required projected channels are finite
available_dimensions.payload: normalized physical load/demand from documented P4 load and P2 speed-demand channels
available_dimensions.velocity: P2_SIT01 measured turbine RPM normalized by the documented 0..3200 RPM range
available_dimensions.geofence_margin: minimum normalized margin to documented physical ranges for projected pressure, level, speed, and vibration channels

projection.normalization: Median and interquartile range are fitted on fit files only, clipped to the 0.5th and 99.5th fit percentiles, and then frozen.

transition_contract.model_input: current masked projected state plus contemporaneous documented actuator/setpoint deltas
transition_contract.action_proxy: move for a material control delta, stop for a documented emergency/trip transition or demand-to-zero transition, inspect for passive observation; no diagnose/approve/repair/verify action is invented

candidate_families: frozen Ferrum simulator-JEPA encoder plus a HAI transition probe

selection.primary_metric: validation masked geometric mean normalized MAE across H=1, H=3, and H=5
secondary_metrics: point precision, recall, F1, and balanced accuracy
selection.thresholding: Fit the residual threshold on normal calibration only. An alert requires at least 3 exceedances in a 5-second window and starts a 30-second cooldown.
selection_tiebreakers: lower validation false alerts per hour

authority_boundary: The HAI model is a domain-specific diagnostic world model. It may produce advisory evidence after an observed transition, but it cannot grant permits, block commands, issue approvals, invoke adapters, or actuate hardware. The existing deterministic supervisor remains the only authority path.
